column1: # Scenarios of the demo monorepo (examples/demo), run by run-scenarios.sh.
# Fields, separated by tabs: name, expectation, change, commit message (optional).
# The expectation is full, full:TEXT, blocked, or the exact jobs that run besides
# smarter-gate. The matrix of worker-test always runs: v0.1 does not prune matrices.
# What each job reads (from its trace): lint the source of the services and the
# schema; api-test and web-test their service and the schema; web-bundle the web
# service without its tests; build the Go package; e2e only scripts/e2e.sh, and it
# follows build, whose workspace it attaches; docs-check docs/; infra-validate

column3: printf '\nRun every check from the directory of its service.\n' >> examples/demo/docs/runbook.md
column4: docs: remind where the checks run

column2: lint api-test build e2e security-scan worker-test-3.12.16 worker-test-3.13.18
column3: sed -i 's|^// newMux returns the routes of the api\.$|// newMux returns the routes of the api, one per endpoint.|' examples/demo/services/api/handler.go

column2: lint web-test web-bundle security-scan worker-test-3.12.16 worker-test-3.13.18
column3: sed -i 's|^// buildGreeting makes the same greeting as the api: the shape of$|// buildGreeting makes the same greeting as the api, in the shape of|' examples/demo/services/web/src/greeting.js

column2: lint api-test web-test security-scan worker-test-3.12.16 worker-test-3.13.18
column3: sed -i 's|The api and the web client both follow it\.|The api and the web client both follow it, in tests too.|' examples/demo/libs/proto/schema.json
sed -i 's|^# their shape, and nothing is applied\.$|# their shape, and nothing is ever applied.|' examples/demo/infra/main.tf

column2: lint api-test build e2e security-scan worker-test-3.12.16 worker-test-3.13.18
column3:
printf '# api

The greeting API of the demo.
' > examples/demo/services/api/README.md
printf '# a scenario touches the pipeline definition\n' >> examples/demo/.circleci/continue.yml
printf '\nThe pipeline runs from the repository root.\n' >> examples/demo/docs/index.md

sed -i 's|^jobs:$|jobs:
  oversized:
    docker:
      - image: cimg/base:2026.11
    resource_class: xlarge
    steps:
      - checkout|; s|^      - lint$|      - lint
      - oversized|' examples/demo/.circleci/continue.yml
column4: ci: add a job on an xlarge resource class
